policy_path_note: §A1.7: if no family passes, fit_policy.py emits a valid spec whose every path is the duration-only fallback (§A1.6), and that is reported as the principal finding (DL-012 §5).

variance_decomposition_caveat.note: Measured on each family's summed SHAP contribution inside the frozen `full` arm, not on its standalone {d̂+Fᵢ} arm (DL-019 §Threats 2).
